description: Comment on a post, or reply to a comment with `parent_comment`. Costs $0.005 per action. Give one of post_id, share_id or post_url. Requires a connected account. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

parent_comment.description: The comment_id of a comment on this post (from post_engagers kind=comments) to reply under.

name: post_comment
title: Comment on a Post
